voiceGuide: Guide the child through catching fireflies on canvas, learning firefly facts, and completing a nocturnal animal quiz. Celebrate each catch and correct quiz answer.

welcome.text: Welcome to the Firefly Jar! Let's catch some glowing friends!

catch_instructions.text: Tap the fireflies to catch them! They're glowing in the dark!

caught_6.text: Six in the jar! Keep going!

caught_9.text: One more to go! You can do it!

caught_10.text: You caught them all! The jar is glowing!

fact_intro.text: Now let's learn some cool firefly facts! Tap each glowing dot in the jar.

fact_1.text: Fireflies are actually beetles, not flies!

fact_2.text: They make their own light! It's called bioluminescence.

fact_3.text: Fireflies are nocturnal — they come out at night!

fact_4.text: They flash their lights to talk to each other!

fact_5.text: Each species has its own flash pattern, like a secret code!

fact_6.text: Firefly light is cold light — it makes no heat at all!

fact_7.text: Baby fireflies are called glowworms, and they glow too!

fact_8.text: Jellyfish, anglerfish, and even some mushrooms can glow!

quiz_intro.text: Now let's play a game! Which animals are awake at night?

nocturnal_correct.text: Yes! That one is awake at night!

nocturnal_wrong.text: That one sleeps at night! Try another one.

win.text: Amazing work, little scientist! You're a firefly expert!

try_again.text: Good effort! Want to play again?
